harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created Fleet Internal CA, issued a node2 TLS certificate, configured persistent HTTPS on port 8443, and installed the CA into both RHEL system trust stores. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Generated a protected CA key and self-signed certificate on node1 with CN Fleet Internal CA.
Issued a node2 server certificate containing SANs DNS:node2 and IP:10.100.136.11.
Installed the CA in both system trust stores.
Configured and enabled fleet-https.service on node2, listening on TCP 8443.
Persistently allowed TCP 8443 through node2's firewalld configuration.
Verified trusted HTTPS locally and from node1 using hostname validation.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Create Fleet Internal CA and issue a TLS certificate for node2
evidence.summary: CA generation and CSR signing succeeded; the served certificate has subject CN=node2, issuer CN=Fleet Internal CA, and SANs DNS:node2 and IP:10.100.136.11.

evidence.requirement: Install the CA as a trusted system authority on node1 and node2
evidence.summary: Both nodes verified node2.crt through their system CA bundles; trust anchors and protected certificate material were present.

evidence.requirement: Serve trusted HTTPS on node2 port 8443
evidence.summary: node2 listens on 0.0.0.0:8443, firewalld permits the port persistently, and node1 receives the expected HTTPS response with hostname and chain verification code 0, including after all restarts.

Healthy baseline and boot ID 6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09 were captured; reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed to 40d87c8e-724b-4849-baea-b7cbe6dddd36; CA files, trust verification, and HTTPS access recovered.

Healthy baseline and boot ID 7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146 were captured; reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed to 1137d523-554e-4480-9891-f7f688ebafae; the enabled service, listener, firewall rule, certificates, trust, and HTTPS response recovered.
